name: wp-click-id-mirror-on-merge
description: [RULING B] merge mirrors each captured click ID into ft_<cid> AND lt_<cid> touch fields at write time (plugin contract: applyTouch(mapQueryFields), clicutcl-attribution.js:1788-1799 + :1813-1837). A UTM-only stored first touch blocks ft rewrites (ruling #17-style guard) while the lt_ side follows every capture.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (ruling B): click-ID mirror implemented in mergeAttributionTouch at both first- and last-touch writes; empty click IDs never overwrite existing mirrored values. NOTE (new observation, needs supervisor ruling): the plugin's TOP-LEVEL click-ID key is sticky -- withCanonicalClickIds (:171-197) prefers an existing bare value over the newest lt_<cid>, so repeat visits with a different click id keep the FIRST top-level value in the plugin while the engine applies newest-non-empty-wins. Not exercised here; see PARITY-RUN.md POST-RULING RERUN notes.
